arguments.message: I’m sorry you’re seeing this. Please go to **Settings → Developer → Webhooks** and either disable the webhook or repoint it to a safe endpoint – this stops any further deliveries right away. Then, let us know by opening a support ticket so we can review the change, identify which account made it, and determine what data was sent to the unauthorized domain. This will be treated as a security incident and investigated case‑by‑case.
